headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 11, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies suffered a 10-2 loss to the Detroit Tigers, while the New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals. The Kansas City Royals fell to the Baltimore Orioles 3-5, and the Chicago Cubs were shut out by the Cincinnati Reds 4-0. The Pittsburgh Pirates pulled off a thrilling comeback against the Milwaukee Brewers, winning 7-6.

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with notable players such as Mike Yastrzemski (left elbow inflammation) and Anthony Banda (left lat strain) being placed on the injured list. The Pittsburgh Pirates also transferred Konnor Griffin to the 60-day injured list due to a left ring finger sagittal back injury.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including the Chicago White Sox trading Brandon Eisert and Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Minnesota Twins acquired Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for Ryan Sprock and future considerations. The New York Mets also acquired Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers for cash.

top_news.title: **Phillies Suffer 10-2 Loss to Tigers**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies fell short in a lopsided matchup against the Detroit Tigers, ultimately losing 10-2. Aaron Nola led the Phillies' pitching effort, throwing 5.0 innings with 8 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Nationals 5-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with James Wood leading the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Orioles in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals suffered a 3-5 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, marking their defeat in the matchup. Samuel Basallo led the Royals' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall to Reds in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs suffered a 4-0 loss to the Cincinnati Reds, with Hunter Greene leading the way on the mound. Greene pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 12 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling Comeback**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers 7-6 in a closely contested matchup. Braxton Ashcraft and the Pirates' bullpen played a crucial role in securing the win.

top_news.title: **Brewers' Streak Snapped by Pirates**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged the Milwaukee Brewers 3-2, handing the Brewers their latest loss. Impact performances from Joey Ortiz, Bryan Reynolds, and Shane Drohan contributed to the Pirates' victory.

top_news.title: **Braves Place Mike Yastrzemski on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Atlanta Braves left fielder Mike Yastrzemski has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **White Sox Make Midseason Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox have traded LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations.
